system.description:
For thousands of years, the people of Egypt protected their tombs and treasure vaults with foul curses invoking the gods' vengeance. This power lets a Setite lay a protective curse upon an object or place, or direct a damaging one against a specific enemy.

System: To curse a person, the Setite must know the victim's name and, if he is a vampire, possess a drop of his blood. The Setite must first devise the curse's nature — a single, specific effect with a specific duration no longer than a lunar cycle. The player spends four Blood Traits and a Willpower Trait, then wins a Manipulation + Occult test against the target's Willpower; success brings the curse into immediate effect, with successes typically imposing a difficulty penalty on the target in appropriate circumstances. To protect a place or object instead, the Setite must state specific triggers to activate the curse, as well as its effect and duration, all of which must be inscribed around the protected place or object.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three: Serpents
